jobs.title: Lead QA Engineer
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote (US) About the Role As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly. Key Responsibilities Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing. Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms. Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet. Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product. Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines. Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance. Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC. Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects. Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward. Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately. Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker. Craft & Leadership Balance Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft. Qualifications Required 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments. Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks. Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms. Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment. Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria. Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem. Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them. Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame. Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects. Preferred Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines). Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. jobs.description: Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. About the Role Across our practices, AI experimentation is organic: agents and accelerators get prototyped, they work, and they find their way to the teams who need them. Working is not the same as dependable, tested, hardened, properly deployed, and fit for a regulated client. Closing that distance and turning experimentation into an engineering discipline is the job. You will build and lead our AI engineering team: you, a Senior Engineer and a DevOps Engineer, and own the path from idea to production across every asset class. You will work with the SMEs within the practices to bring the prioritised pilots into products that deliver return. You are the final technical decision-maker on what ships. Roughly two-thirds of your week is hands-on: architecture, code, review. The rest is direction, hiring and the operating model. You will not be post-technical in this role. Responsibilities Own the AI delivery operating model and the path from prototype to production , from intake, qualification, build, hardening to r ollout across accelerators and client-facing IP.

jobs.title: HR AI and Automation Lead (all genders)
jobs.description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems - not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe - today. Your mission You will own the practical application of AI and automation across HR at STARK. Your goal is to reduce administrative work, improve data quality and give employees and managers faster access to reliable support. You will identify opportunities, build and deploy solutions, and measure their impact across recruiting, people operations and workforce planning. Working with HR leadership, IT, Security, Legal and Finance, you will make these solutions reliable enough for everyday use in a defence technology environment. Responsibilities Own the HR AI and automation roadmap. Prioritise projects by business value, process readiness, data sensitivity and implementation effort, with a clear owner and success measure for each. Build and maintain workflows for recruiting handovers, onboarding, employee changes, approval routing and reporting. Select standard automation or AI according to the task and reliability required. Develop an HR knowledge assistant using approved policies and guidance. Ensure answers reference current sources, respect access permissions and escalate uncertain or sensitive questions to the right person. Connect HR systems and collaboration tools through approved integrations. Improve data consistency, resolve failed handovers and preserve the authoritative source for each record. Improve workforce reporting with reliable headcount, hiring and process data. Help HR and Finance reconcile position approvals, recruitment activity and employee records. Evaluate tools and vendors with IT, Security and Legal. Define access controls, data handling, retention and monitoring before deployment, with accountable human review for decisions affecting candidates or employees. Test output quality, permissions and failure scenarios. Maintain documentation, alerts and recovery procedures so deployed workflows remain dependable as systems and policies change. Train HR colleagues and managers, support adoption and report results through time saved, turnaround times, error rates, usage and operating cost. Qualifications Around five years or more in HR technology, HR operations, business systems or automation, with ownership of projects from problem definition through implementation. Evidence of AI or automation solutions you have deployed and maintained, including the problem solved, adoption achieved and measurable operational results. Practical ability to build integrations using workflow platforms, APIs and webhooks. You can troubleshoot data flows and work with technical colleagues on more complex requirements. Experience applying language models to business workflows, including knowledge retrieval, output evaluation and appropriate escalation when answers are unreliable. An understanding of recruiting and employee lifecycle processes, HR data and the care required when handling confidential candidate and employee information. Strong project ownership and clear communication. You can turn an HR problem into a delivery plan and explain priorities, costs and tradeoffs to senior stakeholders. Professional fluency in English and the judgment to work effectively in a security sensitive, international environment. Nice to have Personio, Greenhouse, Google Workspace, Slack or Confluence; SQL or Python; German language skills; and experience in defence, aerospace, manufacturing or another regulated sector. Equivalent systems and relevant implementation experience are welcome. What success looks like in your first six months: An agreed roadmap with baseline measures and accountable owners for the highest value opportunities. At least three priority workflows in regular use, with documented controls, support ownership and measurable reductions in manual effort or processing time. An HR knowledge assistant piloted with an agreed user group and validated for answer quality, source accuracy and access permissions. A monthly view of adoption, time saved, error rates and operating costs, supported by practical guidance that enables the HR team to use the solutions confidently. Why this role: You will shape how HR supports a growing defence technology business, with direct ownership of solutions used by employees, managers and the HR team. Your work will make hiring and employee operations easier to run as the company scales. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Your profile Senior QA Automation Engineer We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to drive quality for our AI infrastructure platform. We build scheduler and simulator products that work directly with customer datacenter infrastructure for GPUs, helping customers operate and simulate usage across mostly heterogeneous environments. This role requires strong test automation, practical manual testing judgment, Kubernetes and infrastructure understanding, and CI/CD experience. You will help define how we test scheduler and simulator behavior, what we automate, and how quality gates become part of everyday development and release workflows. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain automated tests across scheduler, simulator, APIs, backend services, frontend workflows, integrations, and system-level scenarios. Develop reliable regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, and release test suites that run in CI/CD pipelines and validate Kubernetes-based deployments. Test AI infrastructure workflows for GPU datacenters, heterogeneous resource allocation, configuration changes, failure scenarios, monitoring signals, and rollback behavior. Perform manual exploratory, functional, and regression testing where automation is not yet available or where senior judgment is required for complex infrastructure behavior. Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and platform teams to define test strategy, quality criteria, release readiness, reproducible simulation scenarios, and customer-environment risk areas. Analyze test results, investigate failures, distinguish product defects from environment, infrastructure, data, or test issues, and drive root-cause resolution. Improve CI/CD quality gates, test reporting, flaky-test handling, test data management, environment validation, and automated checks for Kubernetes deployments. Contribute to test framework architecture, tooling choices, Python coding standards, and maintainable automation practices. Document test plans, risks, coverage gaps, simulation assumptions, infrastructure constraints, and release recommendations clearly for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor engineers and QA colleagues on automation best practices, testability, infrastructure-aware QA, and quality ownership. What we're looking for 5+ years of professional QA, SDET, or test automation experience, ideally in infrastructure, platform, cloud, developer tooling, distributed systems, or deep-tech product environments. Strong hands-on test automation experience, especially with Java OR Python/Pytest; ability to write clean, maintainable test code and tooling. Experience building automated tests across APIs, services, integrations, UI workflows, and end-to-end or system-level scenarios. Solid understanding of Kubernetes, containers, Linux environments, deployments, configuration, logs, metrics, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines. Ability to test complex infrastructure products where behavior depends on resource allocation, workload characteristics, environment configuration, and distributed system interactions. Experience with manual exploratory testing, defect isolation, risk-based release decisions, and investigating ambiguous failures in technical systems. Practical experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar. Experience debugging failures using logs, metrics, traces, screenshots, test artifacts, Kubernetes events, container logs, and developer tools. Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with backend, platform, infrastructure, and product teams to improve testability and prevent defects early. Senior-level ownership: able to define priorities, challenge assumptions, improve processes, and deliver without detailed supervision. Nice to have Experience testing AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, schedulers, simulators, cloud platforms, infrastructure products, developer tools, data platforms, or complex distributed systems. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, observability tooling, Linux, networking basics, or platform engineering workflows. Experience testing heterogeneous environments with different GPU types, node configurations, workloads, tenants, quotas, or capacity constraints. Experience with performance, load, scalability, reliability, contract, security, or chaos testing. Experience building test frameworks, internal QA tooling, synthetic workload generators, simulators, or test data pipelines from scratch. Experience with test management, reporting, quality analytics, and release dashboards. Experience coaching teams toward better quality ownership, shift-left testing, and infrastructure-aware QA practices. What this role is not This is not a purely manual QA execution role and not a role focused only on clicking through predefined test cases. We are looking for a senior profile who can design automation strategy, understand technical systems, and active

Strong expertise in core test automation, API testing, CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions), and performance testing (K6)
Extensive background in test strategy, defect lifecycle management, and root cause analysis
